packageRules.description: QMK patch releases are merges of master without breaking changes: merge once CI builds
QMK minor releases are the quarterly breaking-change releases: review by hand
prBodyNotes: This is a QMK breaking-change release. Check the "Changes Requiring User Action" section in https://github.com/qmk/qmk_firmware/tree/master/docs/ChangeLog for anything touching bastardkb/charybdis, pointing devices, tap-hold or the keycodes used in the jigfox keymap before merging.
